group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-03: 'Amaral AC[au]' 292 (a common surname-initial query, an upper bound on one author's output), 'Amaral AC[au] AND WWOX' 0.
group_assessment.weighting: Sponsor study: every author but two was employed by the sponsor, the other two by the contract laboratory, and the sponsor funded it. That cuts BOTH ways here and the direction matters: the paper reports adverse findings that undercut a route its own competitors are in the clinic with, and reports early euthanasia in its own highest-dose arm. A negative safety finding published against interest is the strongest form this evidence takes, so the observations carry full weight; the comparison with a named competitor's disclosed preclinical data is the part written in a commercial frame.

entries.proposition: AFTER THE CSF ROUTE THE SENSORY-GANGLION AND CORD INJURY WAS PRESENT AT EVERY DOSE LEVEL, INCLUDING THE LOWEST, in animals that received no immunosuppression.
entries.snippet: AAV9-GBA1-related histopathology findings were present at all dose levels and affected the DRG, TG, spinal cord, cauda equina, dorsal nerve roots, and peripheral nerves
entries.anchor: Results, 'AAV9-GBA1 ICM and IPa delivery into NHPs produced distinct safety findings', ICM paragraph

entries.proposition: AND THAT IS THE STUDY'S OWN STATEMENT OF ITS IMMUNOLOGICAL CONDITIONS: neither a neutralising-antibody screen nor immunosuppression was used.
entries.snippet: we did not pre-screen for neutralizing antibodies or utilize immunosuppression in the reported results
entries.anchor: Discussion, paragraph comparing this ICM dataset with the PR001 disclosures

entries.proposition: THE PAPER'S ONLY STATEMENT ABOUT IMMUNOSUPPRESSION IS A CITATION TO UNPUBLISHED WORK, NOT A MEASUREMENT IN IT - and even that citation says reduce, not eliminate.
entries.snippet: data from our group suggest that immunosuppression can greatly reduce but not eliminate the severity and/or incidence of DRG, spinal cord, and other adverse histopathology findings
entries.anchor: Discussion, final sentence of the same paragraph

entries.proposition: TOTAL VECTOR PER BRAIN REGION DOES NOT EXPLAIN THE DIFFERENCE IN HARM: mouse and primate reached comparable vector levels with opposite histopathology.
entries.snippet: suggest that the total amount of vector delivered to a brain region is not the primary driver, but perhaps species and/or route of administration

entries.proposition: THE CSF ROUTE BOUGHT NO MEASURABLE BRAIN EFFECT AT ALL IN THIS STUDY, so its sensory-ganglion cost was paid for nothing.
entries.snippet: no significant changes in GCase activity were detected in any brain region analyzed when compared with aCSF control animals
entries.anchor: Results, 'IPa, but not ICM, delivery into NHPs produced enhanced transduction and functional hGCase expression in the brain'
